items.text: Provide for your poor child and maintain them as the justices assess, or forfeit twenty shillings a month.
items.citation: An Act for the Relief of the Poor, 43 Eliz. I c. 2, VII
items.quote: the Father and Grandfather, and the Mother and Grandmother, and the Children ... shall at their own Charges relieve and maintain every such poor Person

heading: Anno Quadragesimo Tertio Elizabethae Reginae, Cap. II. An Act for the Relief of the Poor. · [I.] … IV.

items.text: Keep and maintain your children; if you cannot, the parish will set them to work.
items.citation: An Act for the Relief of the Poor, I
items.quote: whose Parents shall not ... be thought able to keep and maintain their Children

items.text: Serve your master faithfully for the term of your apprenticeship, as if you had bound yourself.
items.citation: An Act for the Relief of the Poor, IV
items.quote: the same to be as effectual to all purposes as if such child were of full age, and by indenture of covenant bound him or herself
